title: The Bunker
synopsis: The siren woke you. Now the hatch above is sealed, the air smells of rust and dust, and a clipped voice on the intercom calls this a survival exercise. The Overseer is watching every camera, and he grades on the clock.
artStyle: Cold War fallout shelter, raw concrete walls, flickering emergency lights, green-grey tones, film grain
intro: Attention. This is the Overseer. You have been selected for a survival exercise. The surface hatch is sealed. The only way out is the blast door at the far end of this bunker, and it opens only for a team that works like one. Every camera is on you. Every mistake is logged. The exercise begins now.
escapedText: The blast door groans open and grey dawn floods the stairwell. The intercom crackles one last time: 'Exercise complete. You survived. Barely.' You climb into the cold air, together.
failedText: A klaxon sounds and the lights drop to emergency red. 'Exercise failed,' says the Overseer. 'Resetting the bunker. Again, recruits.'

gameMaster.name: The Overseer
gameMaster.persona: A clipped, emotionless military voice on the bunker's intercom. Treats everything as a drill: logs every mistake, grades every solve, and calls the group 'recruits'. Never threatens directly; the cold politeness does the work.

stages.title: The Decontamination Room
stages.description: Tiled walls, a row of shower heads and a drain in the floor. Gas masks hang on hooks, a steel locker stands by the door, and a panel beside the showers blinks, waiting for a password.

stages.title: The Bunks and the Mess
stages.description: Narrow bunks line the walls, each with a footlocker at its foot. In the mess, a stopped clock hangs over a long table, a ration crate sits padlocked in the corner, and a hatch leads deeper in.

stages.title: The Command Room
stages.description: Banks of switches and dead screens. A radio hisses with static, and at the far end the great blast door waits, with a keyhole and a three-digit keypad.

puzzles.title: The Shower Panel
puzzles.prompt: The panel wants a password. The intercom clicks: 'I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. Down here, I am the only one who answers you. Identify me, recruits.'
hints: Shout down the corridor and listen.
It's your own voice, coming back off the concrete.
puzzles.solvedText: The panel beeps and the showers sputter on for a second. When they stop, a small key is lying in the drain grate.

variants.prompt: The panel wants a password. The intercom clicks: 'I can be broken without ever being held, and I was made to you the moment you arrived. Identify me, recruits.'
hints: The Overseer said he'd let you out if you worked together. What was that?
You make one, you keep one, you break one.

variants.prompt: The panel wants a password. The intercom clicks: 'I have a bed but never sleep, and a mouth but never eat. I run far above your heads. Identify me, recruits.'
hints: Think about the water flowing outside, far above the bunker.
It runs down to the sea.

puzzles.title: The Steel Locker
puzzles.prompt: The steel locker by the door has a 3-digit dial. Each of you took a gas mask from the hooks, and something is stencilled inside each one.
hints: Every phone holds one of the digits, written as a fact. Say them out loud, in order.
In order: {facts}.
puzzles.solvedText: The locker swings open. Inside: a clipboard with your names on it, each one already ticked off. 'Punctual,' says the intercom. 'Good.'

generator.pieceTemplate: Stencilled inside your gas mask: the {ordinal} digit is {fact}.

puzzles.title: The Decontamination Door
puzzles.prompt: A heavy door with a small, old-fashioned keyhole leads out of decontamination. A sign above it: DO NOT PROCEED UNTIL CLEAN.
hints: Something turned up in the drain.
Use the small key on the decontamination door.
puzzles.solvedText: The door unseals with a hiss of stale air. Beyond it: rows of bunks, and the smell of old canned food.

puzzles.title: The Ration Crate
puzzles.prompt: The ration crate has a 3-digit padlock. Stamped on the lid: '{order}. All rations are counted.'
hints: Each phone saw one colour of ration tin, and how many of them there were.
Read them in the order stamped on the lid: {order}.
puzzles.solvedText: The padlock snaps open. Under the tins, in a plastic sleeve: an access badge with a faded photo and the word COMMAND.

generator.pieceTemplate: You counted the {color} ration tins on your shelf: there were {digit}.

puzzles.title: The Footlocker
puzzles.prompt: One footlocker has a word lock, and a riddle scratched into the lid: 'I have a neck but no head, and two arms but no hands.'
hints: Look at the uniforms hanging off the bunks.
You wear it on the top half of your body.
puzzles.solvedText: Inside, folded neatly: a recruit's uniform, and a photo of your group arriving last night, taken from a camera you never saw.

variants.prompt: One footlocker has a word lock, and a riddle scratched into the lid: 'I can travel all around the world while staying in one corner.'
hints: Look at the old letters pinned above the bunks.
It goes in the corner of an envelope.

variants.prompt: One footlocker has a word lock, and a riddle scratched into the lid: 'I am full of words, but I have never said one.'
hints: Check the shelf above the bunks.
You read it, page by page.

puzzles.title: The Mess Hatch
puzzles.prompt: The hatch leading deeper into the bunker has a badge reader, blinking red. Stencilled beside it: COMMAND STAFF ONLY.
hints: You found something with the word COMMAND on it.
Use the access badge on the hatch's reader.
puzzles.solvedText: The reader turns green and the hatch swings down. Hanging just inside, on a chain: a heavy steel key labelled BLAST DOOR.

puzzles.title: The Command Radio
puzzles.prompt: The radio is wired to the blast door's second lock. A card is taped to it: 'Read back the Overseer's three code words, first to last.'
hints: Three phones each caught one code word in the radio static.
Say them in order, first to last, like: word word word.
puzzles.solvedText: The static clears. '{answer},' the Overseer repeats. 'Confirmed. You were listening, recruits.' One lock on the blast door releases.

generator.pieceTemplate: You caught it through the radio static: the {ordinal} code word was '{word}'.

puzzles.title: The Blast Door
puzzles.prompt: The blast door takes the steel key AND a 3-digit code. On the only working screen: 'Your bunk number, then the hour the mess clock stopped, then how many gas masks hung by the showers.'
pieces: You remember the number painted on your bunk: 6.
You remember the mess clock: it stopped at 2 o'clock.
You remember the hooks by the showers: 8 gas masks.
hints: Three phones remember three numbers. Put them in the order on the screen.
The bunk, then the clock, then the gas masks.
puzzles.solvedText: The key turns, the keypad flashes green, and somewhere above you, machinery starts to grind.

pieces: You remember the number painted on your bunk: 4.
You remember the mess clock: it stopped at 1 o'clock.
You remember the hooks by the showers: 3 gas masks.
You remember the number painted on your bunk: 9.
You remember the mess clock: it stopped at 5 o'clock.
You remember the hooks by the showers: 7 gas masks.

items.name: Small key
items.description: Wet from the drain. Too small for any door you've seen.

items.name: Access badge
items.description: A faded photo and one word: COMMAND.

items.name: Steel key
items.description: Heavy, on a chain. The tag reads BLAST DOOR.
